decision_conditions: The proposed work is to be carried out to British Standard 3998 (2010) Tree Work Recommendations, by a reputable tree surgeon to the satisfaction of the Tree Preservation Officer who should be informed of the date of commencement of work.
application_type_full: Tree works: Trees in conservation areas/subject to TPOs
description:
T1 London Plane tree - 
London Plane:
Reduce laterally the branches within construction site, reduce the branches back to old pruning points to ensure safety of scaffolding when erected.
To crown raise over drive entrance, one low hanging branch to be removed, to prevent damage to large vehicles and machinery coming in and out of the site.
To remove deadwood from canopy.
To sever ivy at base and remove all Ivy growth from tree. Doing so will reveal the basal area, stem and any unions hidden by the Ivy.
